caseName: McGowan v. J. H. Winchester & Co.
caseNameFull: McGowan v. J. H. Winchester & Co., Inc. and Buro v. American Petroleum Transport Corp.
attorneys: Jacob Rassner, Nathan Baker and Thomas O’Rourke Gallagher for petitioners., John L. Quinlan for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for an extension of time nunc pro

tunc to file petition for writs of certiorari denied. Petition for writs of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied for the reason that application therefor was not made within the time provided by law.

Reported below: 168 F. 2d 924.
